audience: small business owners and sales teams who keep contacts, tasks and deals in Less Annoying CRM

useCases.title: Find a contact or company with its latest notes
useCases.text: The AI searches contacts and companies, opens one record with all its fields, and lists its notes, newest first. You get the history in one answer.

useCases.title: See the tasks due in a date range
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks due in a date range, only incomplete or complete ones, for chosen users. You see what is open this week.

useCases.title: Review the deals in a pipeline by status
useCases.text: The AI lists the items in a pipeline, with the statuses of the pipeline, and can filter by status or user. You get a picture of your deals by stage.

useCases.title: Add a note, task or event to a contact
useCases.text: The AI adds a plain-text note to a contact or company, creates a task, or schedules a calendar event with attendees. It saves you typing after a call.

useCases.title: Add or edit a contact, move a deal or complete a task
useCases.text: The AI creates or edits a contact or company, moves a pipeline item to another status, or marks a task complete or open again.

useCases.title: Add a contact to a pipeline or a group
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact to a pipeline with a status, or to a contact group, and lists the groups and their members. It helps you sort leads and customers.
